summary: TEMPLATE SWITCHING BUG FIX VERIFIED - Critical test passed: Switching from 'Neon Test' (with background images) to 'Clean Blue' (without background images) correctly clears the previous template's properties. The loadTemplate function now uses DEFAULT_STYLE as base.
critical_code_review_comments: WebsiteDesignManager.js line 236: loadTemplate now uses DEFAULT_STYLE spread as base: const mergedStyle = { ...DEFAULT_STYLE, ...template.style }
This ensures properties from previous templates (like bannerBackgroundImage) are properly cleared when loading a new template
editingStyleRef (line 68) is properly kept in sync with editingStyle state for reliable state access in handleSave
seed_data_creation: None - used existing templates: Neon Test, Clean Blue, Dark Theme
